_README_trading_enabled: true = place REAL orders. false = monitor-only (compute signals + SL/BE/TP, place nothing). Run with --dry to force monitor-only regardless of this flag.
_README_balance_override: 0 = read equity from the Bybit wallet-balance API. If a copy-trading account does not expose its balance via the API, set this to the USDT equity the bot should size orders against.
_README_account: Copy Trading Master Trader account. The API key must have 'Contract - Orders & Positions' permission. Symbol must be in One-Way position mode.
_README_strategy: Divergence-Flip v1 (config #5). ALL strategy params — LEVERAGE, RISK_PCT, DCA levels/spacing/martingale, SL_FROM_WORST, TP_PCT, BE trigger/buffer/trail — live in core_divflip.py and are IDENTICAL to the paper bot (strategies/day/bot_divflip.py). Edit core_divflip.py to change them.
_WARNING: Divflip is documented OVERFIT. Year-wise out-of-sample backtest 2021-2026 (BTCUSDT 5m) = -100%, account wiped. The +189% headline was in-sample. See memory/divflip_tv_tuned_live.md. Deploying live trades real money against that result.
